comment: Values approximate; verify against NASA sources.
notes: Data downlinked per pass = data_rate_bps x pass_seconds. Tape capacity is in bits (1 MB = 8,000,000 bits). Ground station passes are for LEO; higher orbits give longer passes but weaker signals.

radios.name: Beacon transmitter
radios.description: Low-rate, low-power tone beacon. Enough for tracking and a trickle of data.
radios.source: Inspired by the real 108 MHz beacons on Vanguard 1 and Explorer 1, 1958.

radios.name: Telemetry radio
radios.description: Standard transmitter for orbital science data.
radios.source: Inspired by real Explorer-class and TIROS-class telemetry transmitters, 1958-60.

radios.name: Wideband radio
radios.description: High-rate link for TV pictures. Heavy and power hungry.
radios.source: Inspired by real Telstar and TIROS video transmitters, 1960-62.

radios.name: Deep-space radio
radios.description: Long-range link good out to the Moon.
radios.source: Inspired by the real Ranger / Surveyor probe transmitters, 1960s.

ground_stations.name: Cape Canaveral station
ground_stations.description: A single tracking station; a few passes a day.
ground_stations.source: Inspired by the real Minitrack network station at Cape Canaveral, 1958.

ground_stations.name: Minitrack network
ground_stations.description: A handful of stations around the world. More passes, more data.
ground_stations.source: Inspired by the real NASA Minitrack tracking network, 1957-60s.

ground_stations.name: Global tracking network
ground_stations.source: Inspired by the real Mercury Space Flight Network (18 stations), 1961.

tape_recorders.name: Small tape recorder
tape_recorders.description: Holds a few minutes of low-rate data between passes.
tape_recorders.source: Inspired by the real miniature tape recorder on Explorer 3 (1958).

tape_recorders.name: Standard tape recorder
tape_recorders.description: A few megabytes: enough for a day of low-rate instruments.
tape_recorders.source: Inspired by the real tape recorders on TIROS and Explorer satellites, 1960s.

tape_recorders.name: Large tape recorder
tape_recorders.description: Bulky, but can buffer TV imagery between passes.
tape_recorders.source: Inspired by the real video tape recorders flown on Nimbus and Ranger-era missions, 1960s.
